程序包 org.bukkit.entity

接口 Villager.Profession

所有超级接口:
java.lang.Comparable<Villager.Profession>, net.kyori.adventure.key.Keyed, Keyed, OldEnum<Villager.Profession>, net.kyori.adventure.translation.Translatable
封闭接口:
Villager
public static interface Villager.Profession extends OldEnum<Villager.Profession>, Keyed, net.kyori.adventure.translation.Translatable
表示村民可能拥有的各种不同职业。 村民根据其职业有不同的交易选项。

原文： Represents the various different Villager professions there may be. Villagers have different trading options depending on their profession,

  • 字段详细资料

    • ARMORER

      static final Villager.Profession ARMORER
      盔甲匠职业。穿着黑色围裙。盔甲匠主要交易铁盔甲、锁链盔甲，有时还有钻石盔甲。

      原文： Armorer profession. Wears a black apron. Armorers primarily trade for iron armor, chainmail armor, and sometimes diamond armor.

    • BUTCHER

      static final Villager.Profession BUTCHER
      屠夫职业。穿着白色围裙。屠夫主要交易生食和熟食。

      原文： Butcher profession. Wears a white apron. Butchers primarily trade for raw and cooked food.

    • CARTOGRAPHER

      static final Villager.Profession CARTOGRAPHER
      制图师职业。穿着白色长袍。制图师主要交易探索地图和一些纸张。

      原文： Cartographer profession. Wears a white robe. Cartographers primarily trade for explorer maps and some paper.

    • CLERIC

      static final Villager.Profession CLERIC
      牧师职业。穿着紫色长袍。牧师主要交易腐肉、金锭、红石、青金石、末影珍珠、荧石和附魔之瓶。

      原文： Cleric profession. Wears a purple robe. Clerics primarily trade for rotten flesh, gold ingot, redstone, lapis, ender pearl, glowstone, and bottle o' enchanting.

    • FARMER

      static final Villager.Profession FARMER
      农民职业。穿着棕色长袍。农民主要交易与食物相关的物品。

      原文： Farmer profession. Wears a brown robe. Farmers primarily trade for food-related items.

    • FISHERMAN

      static final Villager.Profession FISHERMAN
      渔夫职业。穿着棕色长袍。渔夫主要交易鱼类，也可能出售线和/或煤炭。

      原文： Fisherman profession. Wears a brown robe. Fisherman primarily trade for fish, as well as possibly selling string and/or coal.

    • FLETCHER

      static final Villager.Profession FLETCHER
      制箭师职业。穿着棕色长袍。制箭师主要交易线、弓和箭。

      原文： Fletcher profession. Wears a brown robe. Fletchers primarily trade for string, bows, and arrows.

    • LEATHERWORKER

      static final Villager.Profession LEATHERWORKER
      皮匠职业。穿着白色围裙。皮匠主要交易皮革和皮革盔甲，以及鞍。

      原文： Leatherworker profession. Wears a white apron. Leatherworkers primarily trade for leather, and leather armor, as well as saddles.

    • LIBRARIAN

      static final Villager.Profession LIBRARIAN
      图书管理员职业。穿着白色长袍。图书管理员主要交易纸张、书籍和附魔书。

      原文： Librarian profession. Wears a white robe. Librarians primarily trade for paper, books, and enchanted books.

    • MASON

      static final Villager.Profession MASON
      石匠职业。

      原文： Mason profession.

    • NITWIT

      static final Villager.Profession NITWIT
      傻瓜职业。穿着绿色围裙，不能交易。傻瓜村民不做任何事情。默认情况下他们没有任何交易。

      原文： Nitwit profession. Wears a green apron, cannot trade. Nitwit villagers do not do anything. They do not have any trades by default.

    • NONE

      static final Villager.Profession NONE

    • SHEPHERD

      static final Villager.Profession SHEPHERD
      牧羊人职业。穿着棕色长袍。牧羊人主要交易羊毛物品和剪刀。

      原文： Shepherd profession. Wears a brown robe. Shepherds primarily trade for wool items, and shears.

    • TOOLSMITH

      static final Villager.Profession TOOLSMITH
      工具匠职业。穿着黑色围裙。工具匠主要交易铁制和钻石工具。

      原文： Toolsmith profession. Wears a black apron. Tool smiths primarily trade for iron and diamond tools.

    • WEAPONSMITH

      static final Villager.Profession WEAPONSMITH
      武器匠职业。穿着黑色围裙。武器匠主要交易铁制和钻石武器，有时是附魔的。

      原文： Weaponsmith profession. Wears a black apron. Weapon smiths primarily trade for iron and diamond weapons, sometimes enchanted.
